findings.subject: Real Native then real VM from equal complete preimages
findings.detail: PairEngine assembles the fixed generated asset, verifies first f0 ABI (readbuf,mutbuf,mutbuf)->u32 and effects, maps fixed actual compile output via NativeHiaJsonImage, and retains the actual ctypes function pointer. Session.call invokes that entry once, then a new _Machine.invoke once. Source is fresh per call; mutable buffers persist across a head session. Actual native and VM complete preimages are compared before invocation. Native mapping source was independently fullGET; it uses mmap+mprotect and the three-buffer ctypes ABI. Runtime source was fullGET: invoke does not automatically expire borrowed input views at return; loan.end explicitly expires a view, and subsequent active-owner/view assertions detect that.

findings.subject: Complete full-buffer and physical guard coverage
findings.detail: Each returned pair retains 6 Native logical before/after files, 6 physical before/after files, and 3 VM-after files. Each physical span is logical length+128 with two exact 64B guards; Native spans and VM owners are distinct. Parent frames() rereads all 15 payloads, verifies full SHA/Git/length, physical/logical slices, fixed guards, extents/non-overlap, source immutability and complete equality of all three Native-after and VM-after buffers. findings.detail: Native and VM observations are in finally blocks for Python-visible exits; exceptions and partial frames remain.
